race.comment: Huge field and plenty of win chances in an even contest. GOLD ARMOUR (5) was a close-up fourth two back then finished fifth here last time but beaten only half a length in a busy finish. Has upside and looks tough to stop. CHEF'S KISS (2) is a former NSW galloper having his first run for the new yard but comes fit and with figures good enough to test this line-up. Huge watch on the betting. GEEGEES AVALANCHE (4) was beaten 6 lengths when sixth in a 1200m contest at this track two-and-a-half weeks ago. Finally draws a gate and can run well. SIR WILLIAM (7) ran below expectations last time at Devonport Synthetic, finishing sixth. Finds a nice race and can make amends. ROLAND VIEW (10) will come on from the debut run.
